method: Interactive app-browser checks on an isolated local test origin
checks: Home starts with Movies you might like, Saved movies, and Watch again; watched editor is on a separate page
Recommendation row contains ten movie previews and an eleventh See more tile
Arrow control moves the horizontal scroll position; desktop document does not overflow
Recommendation See more opens its collection and preserves the first ten titles
Load more produces 48 cards with 48 distinct movie IDs
Saved movie and Watch again See more links open the matching full lists
Genre collection contains only its selected genre and survives refresh
Watched page can search, add, remove, and rate films
Low-rated watched film remains in history but is excluded from Watch again
Without favorites, genre rows follow watched-genre counts
Selecting Comedy replaces inferred genre rows with the explicit favorite
Desktop screenshots captured for Home, watched history, and a genre collection
